Opt in to OCR elements to get each word's text, bounding box and confidence

```ruby title="Ruby"
require "xberg"
result = Xberg.extract(Xberg::ExtractInput.new(kind: 'uri', mime_type: 'image/png', uri: 'https://example.com/images/test_hello_world.png'), { 'force_ocr' => true, 'ocr' => { 'backend' => 'tesseract', 'element_config' => { 'include_elements' => true, 'min_level' => 'word' }, 'enabled' => true, 'language' => ['eng'] } })
puts result.results[0].ocr_elements.inspect
```
